#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

namespace geo {

template <typename T>
class Vector {
public:
    explicit Vector(std::size_t n) : data_(n) {}
    T& operator[](std::size_t i) { return data_[i]; }
    const T& operator[](std::size_t i) const { return data_[i]; }
    std::size_t size() const noexcept { return data_.size(); }
    virtual ~Vector() = default;

private:
    std::vector<T> data_;
};

}  // namespace geo

auto make_shared_vector(int n) -> std::shared_ptr<geo::Vector<int>> {
    return std::make_shared<geo::Vector<int>>(n);
}

static const char* raw = R"delim(a raw
string with "quotes")delim";

int main() {
    auto v = make_shared_vector(3);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < v->size(); ++i) {
        (*v)[i] = static_cast<int>(i * i);
    }
    std::cout << "size: " << v->size() << '\n';
    constexpr double pi = 3.14159;
    std::unique_ptr<int[]> buffer{new int[16]{}};
    [&](int x) mutable { return x + 1; }(2);
    /* a block
       comment */
    if (v->size() > 2 && pi < 4.0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("bad");
    }
    return 0;
}
